title: Explosion in Northern Israel Injures At Least 20, Including Students and Teachers
detail: An explosion in northern Israel injured at least 20 people, including students and teachers, in what authorities described as a cross-border or internal security incident. The blast occurred in a region already under elevated alert amid ongoing tensions, raising concerns about escalation in areas beyond the Gaza and West Bank fronts.
